question: In the IF route released as this year's April Fools' project, I was shocked that Olbart-san, who tormented Subaru so much in Arc 7, was killed by Arakiya, although I imagine Todd's assistance played a part as well. If possible, I'd love to know how Olbart-san was killed, what his final words were, and also his birthday.
answer:
For his birthday, then… Respect for the Aged Day! (※)

First of all, Arakiya is incredibly strong.

If Todd launches a surprise attack while Olbart is distracted by Arakiya, even Olbart is going to die.

As for how he was killed, I imagine it went something like this: Todd instructed Arakiya to “lure him here,” Arakiya led him there, and then Todd used his Divine Protection of Vanishing to make himself completely undetectable before attacking Olbart from behind and killing him.

Because it was a surprise attack, Olbart died without being able to leave any final words.

I don't think Arakiya herself would have much motivation to kill Olbart, though…

She's on good terms with Olbart, so I think she'd hesitate. But in that route, Priscilla is beside Arakiya, so I think Arakiya would cooperate because she doesn't want Priscilla to abandon her.

(※ Editorial note: Respect for the Aged Day is currently the third Monday of September, but it was originally September 15, and in 2025 it also fell on September 15. Therefore, Olbart's birthday was established as September 15.)
